commentary.text: 90+3' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+2' The resulting set piece from Girona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+1' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Diego Cocca prepares a substitution. Marcos Andre is replaced by Adrian Arnuncio (Valladolid).
87' The substitution has been made. Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) has replaced Ivan Martin.
87' Lucas Rosa (Valladolid) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
83' Michel decides to make a substitution. Donny van de Beek will be replaced by Yangel Herrera (Girona).
83' Substitution. Portu (Girona) on for Bryan Gil.
81' 3 - 0 Arnau Martinez feeds the ball through to Arnaut Danjuma (Girona), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the top left corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 3:0!
78' Girona fail to score from a corner as Karl Hein (Valladolid) leaps to collect the ball.

78' Arnau Martinez (Girona) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Girona have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
77' The attendance is 9534.
75' Here's the change. Stanko Juric leaves the pitch and Raul Moro (Valladolid) comes on as a substitute.

74' The most active player in today's match is definitely Bryan Gil (Girona). He's trying to be on the ball as much as possible and you can literally see the enthusiasm in his play. He keeps exchanging some one touch passes and waits for the right moment to send a killer pass. What a player!
72' Substitution. Cristhian Stuani (Girona) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Abel Ruiz walks off.
71' Michel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) replacing Yaser Asprilla.
70' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Girona comes to nothing.

70' Excellent touch by Bryan Gil (Girona)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and produces a low drive towards the right post. The goalkeeper pulls off a beautiful save to deny him. The linesman makes the right call and Girona will have a corner.

68' A long pass finds Mario Martin (Valladolid), and he decides to test the keeper from long range. The shot flies towards the right side of the goal, but Paulo Gazzaniga reacts well to make a good save.
66' Girona enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
64' Arnau Martinez (Girona) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Valladolid earn a free kick.
64' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Donny van de Beek (Girona) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
61' Ivan Sanchez comes off the pitch to be replaced by Selim Amallah (Valladolid).
60' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ivan Martin (Girona) was quite harsh and Pablo Fuertes didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
60' A cross from a corner kick by Girona is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
59' Bryan Gil (Girona) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. It will be a corner kick for Girona.
59' Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.

57' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) latches on to the corner kick and releases a quick strike from the edge of the box. The result differs significantly from his intention as the ball flies way over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valladolid.
57' Bryan Gil (Girona) prepares to take a corner kick.
54' The free kick from long range, taken by Valladolid, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
54' Pablo Fuertes shows a yellow card to Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) for his blatant foul.
51' Girona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
51' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
48' David Lopez (Girona) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Girona.
45+3' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Girona get a corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
43' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.

39' 2 - 0 Miguel Gutierrez showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Abel Ruiz (Girona) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header into the bottom right corner. It's 2:0.

37' Post! Abel Ruiz (Girona) pounces on the rebound inside the penalty box and tries to prod home! He's unlucky as the ball only rattles the left post. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.
35' Mario Martin (Valladolid) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Pablo Fuertes blows his whistle for a foul. Girona win a free kick.

31' 1 - 0 David Lopez (Girona) deflects his teammate's shot, which was heading in the opposite direction, using his body. The goalkeeper reacted to the earlier shot and the deflection confused him. No chance of stopping that.
31' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
30' Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Pablo Fuertes had an easy-decision to make. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Valladolid.
27' Arnau Martinez (Girona) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but powers his header just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valladolid.
24' Abel Ruiz (Girona) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Pablo Fuertes lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
24' Abel Ruiz (Girona) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
24' Abel Ruiz (Girona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
23' Abel Ruiz (Girona) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
21' Ivan Martin (Girona) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Pablo Fuertes has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Valladolid are awarded the free kick.
20' A pass into the box finds Yaser Asprilla (Girona) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the right side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Karl Hein denies him.
18' Ivan Martin (Girona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Karl Hein, who smothers the ball.
18' The resulting free kick from Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
16' Daley Blind (Girona) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot at goal. His effort is blocked by Karl Hein with a brilliant diving save!
11' Valladolid fail to score from a corner as Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona) leaps to collect the ball.
10' The free kick from long range, taken by Valladolid, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee blows his whistle, Valladolid are awarded a corner kick.
10' Daley Blind (Girona) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Pablo Fuertes signals. Valladolid have a free kick.
9' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) sends a cross into the box, but Karl Hein comes off his line to gather the ball.
7' A corner kick by Girona is thwarted by the well prepared Karl Hein (Valladolid).
6' Girona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Now Girona have a corner.

6' Karl Hein pulls off a great save to deny Yaser Asprilla (Girona), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the top right corner. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Girona.
4' Daley Blind (Girona) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Girona.
4' Neat passing move from Girona in order to create new attacking opportunities.

2' Donny van de Beek (Girona) beats the defender to the lofted pass inside the box, but can't control his shot and it flashes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Valladolid will take the kick-off.
Pablo Fuertes will supervise the game today.
